about.title: About Butcher's Swimming Pool Supply & Service
text: Founded in 1958, Butcher’s Swimming Pool Supply & Service is a 3rd generation family-owned and operated company. Although we continue to service residential swimming pools, we expanded our services approximately 30 years ago to meet the service needs of commercial accounts as well. Our fountain cleaning specialists have vast experience having worked on-site at many prominent office complexes and retail centers around Houston.
Butcher’s Swimming Pool has been going strong for three generations. Currently owned by Collin Butcher, this local gem was actually started by Richard Butcher, Collin’s grandfather in 1958.

Richard, a long-time Houston resident, opened a small, family-run swimming pool supply shop with the promise of making pool care and maintenance as painless as possible. A practical man, and somewhat of a chemist, Richard was among the first to formulate and bottle pool algaecide. His product, Sparkle, marked the beginning for him and his family in the swimming pool industry.
